title: Peas Wet: modeled ₹506/qtl left, Naraingarh → Una
summary: January 2023: reported peas Wet prices at Naraingarh and Una imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 100% of 22 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹506 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 174 same-variety market pairs screened for peas Wet in January 2023; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Una report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2023
scenes.caption: Naraingarh (Haryana) and Una (Himachal Pradesh) both reported peas Wet prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 22 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Naraingarh reported a median ₹1,800 per quintal. Una reported a median ₹2,600 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹800/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹800 per quintal, and Una was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 188 km by road
scenes.caption: 188 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~3 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹40/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹525 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹385 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Una report, the rule selects 21 of 22 modeled shipping days. 21 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹506 per quintal (₹364 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Peas Wet route from Naraingarh to Una was positive on 100% of matched days in January 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹50,600, or ₹36,400 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to peas Wet
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹40/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Peas Wet route from Naraingarh to Una was positive on 100% of matched days in January 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹50,600, or ₹36,400 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
